title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Java, Selenium, Github)
description:

* Have Bachelor's Degree BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech or MCA with minimum 6 years of professional experience.

* Have a good experience in Selenium and Github
* Have experience of testing web services (SOAP/REST; Throughput, Performance under Load, etc.)-
* Have experience in working with virtual machines (VMs) as part of a test/integration infrastructure

* Effective team building and problem solving abilities

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
  
  
  

* Starting early / finishing early
* Starting late / finishing late

**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Supplier Quality Engineer**

Location: CCPL Engineering, Navi Mumbai

**Experience:**
5+ years of hands-on quality engineering in medical devices, pharma, aerospace or automotive industry

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own product quality across our orthopedic surgical instrument manufacturing business. In this role, you will drive first-pass yield up and customer rejects down. You will lead root cause investigations, close the gap between our inspection results and our customers' incoming inspection, and work closely with our manufacturing partners to raise the quality of the parts we receive from them.

Please find more information about the company here: https://ccplengg.com/

**Key Responsibilities:**

·      Candidates should possess skills in Supplier Evaluation and Supplier Quality to assess and qualify manufacturing partners.

·      Supplier quality: Own incoming inspection of partner shipments; qualify and audit machining and finishing partners, run first article inspections, verify material certifications (ASTM F899, A564) and manage supplier corrective actions.

·      Partner process control: Get control plans, PFMEA, in-process checks and SPC in place at partner sites for critical features, so defects are caught at the source.

·      Reduce rejects and improve yield: Track first-pass yield, scrap, rework and customer rejects by part and supplier; lead projects that measurably bring them down.

·      Root cause and CAPA: Lead structured investigations (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa) into nonconformances and customer complaints; own corrective actions through to verified effectiveness.

·      Drawing and GD&T review: Review customer drawings per ASME Y14.5 before production; flag unspecified dimensions, ambiguous datums and malformed callouts with the customer up front.

·      Quality system: Keep our processes and records aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR 820) expectations as a registered contract manufacturer — NCR/MRB, device history records, document control and audit readiness.

·      Customer communication: Act as the technical quality contact for international customers — investigation reports, SCAR responses and clear written updates.

**Required Qualifications:**

·      B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.

·      At least 5 years of hands-on quality engineering experience in medical device, pharmaceutical equipment or aerospace manufacturing.

·      Strong command of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and reading complex engineering drawings.

·      Proven record of quality projects that increased throughput or reduced rejects, with numbers to show for it.

·      Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

·      Ability to work on multiple projects across different industries.

**Preferred Skills:**

·      Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a Lean manufacturing certification.

·      Experience working within a customer's quality system as a supplier or contract manufacturer.

·      Experience with orthopedic instruments or implants, and stainless steel (420, 17-4 PH, 465) or titanium parts.

·      Supplier quality engineering experience, driving improvement at external manufacturers.

**Perks & Benefits:**

·      A high-impact role with direct ownership of quality outcomes for Global medical device customers.

·      The chance to shape CCPL's supplier quality program and how we work with our manufacturing partners.

·      Work in a collaborative, close-knit team with direct access to leadership.

·      Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks, with strong potential for career and salary growth.

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday – 10:00 – 18:00

Ability to commute/relocate: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Production Engineering/Industrial Engineering or related field

Experience: 5+ years in quality engineering — medical device, pharma, aerospace or automotive manufacturing

Language: English (required)

Work Location: In person, with periodic visits to supplier sites

Interested candidates: Please submit your resume along with a cover letter to sreeramgm@ccplengg.com.

In your cover letter, describe one quality improvement project you led and the results it delivered.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: Data Coordinator (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To coordinate and drive the governance of commercial data quality across SAPAC — ensuring the accuracy, integrity and reliability of key commercial data and analytics — with ownership of the data remaining with the region's markets and functions.
  
  
The Data Coordinator leads the regional data governance function: monitoring data quality, facilitating improvement, coordinating audits, controls, standards, reporting and market execution, making issues transparent and escalating where necessary, while serving as SAPAC's representative in Getinge's global data governance network. Alongside the Data Steward, the role runs the region's verification and audit cadence and supports designated markets directly; as Lead, it additionally owns the Steering Committee reporting pack and carries named accountability for the regional baseline and governance plan.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Establish the capability (first 90 days)**

* Be formally registered as SAPAC Data Coordinator with Global Master Data Management; join the global Data Coordinator network and cadence; receive the relevant global data quality reporting, including the installed base quality report
* Adopt the global governance principles, definitions and available standards as the starting point for all regional work; identify where global standards apply before any regional standard is considered
* Establish the regional data governance scorecard and baseline each market against it, presenting it as the Steering Committee's standing Data Health Dashboard (named accountability)
* Stand up the Steering Committee reporting pack and a monthly service-findings call with the SAPAC Service Director
* Agree with the Steering Committee which markets are designated for direct execution, and establish the review-and-approval workflow with each market's Finance Director or nominated data owner
* With the Data Steward, agree the allocation of markets and recurring tasks between the two roles for committee approval

**Lead accountabilities (ongoing)**

* Prepare the Steering Committee pack each cycle: scorecard movement, audit findings, execution volumes, governance/execution time split, escalations
* Represent SAPAC in the global Data Coordinator network: bring regional issues, gaps and requirements into the global governance process
* Escalate systemic issues that cannot be resolved regionally through the global process rather than creating local workarounds
* Facilitate business-owned regional standards (see below) and monitor their adoption by market
* Apply the agreed prioritisation rule between committee meetings; escalate unresolved conflicts to the chair

**Run the regional governance cadence**

* Quarterly audit of annual price-increase application by market — timeliness of list and contract price application, with revenue impact of any delay (distinct from the per-load accuracy verification run by the Data Steward)
* Quarterly credit-note root-cause analysis and trending by market and category — asking why each pattern occurs and which process or ownership issue sits behind it
* Quarterly reporting of service-contract renewal timing against the regional standard
* Half-yearly field-safety traceability tests: verify that sampled equipment can be located to a functional location and customer within target time
* Coordinate the installed base accuracy programme: the global IB report relationship, the country accuracy score, and escalations — data ownership stays with the market and service organisation; corrections are executed by the Data Steward
* Interpret cost-to-price reconciliation results in the quarterly report (reconciliations are run by the Data Steward)
* Share recurring verification and reporting across markets with the Data Steward under the agreed allocation

**Execution for designated markets**

* Review price files prepared by the Data Steward before load, and coordinate the Finance Director sign-off workflow for each designated market
* Ensure every executed change carries a documented market approval so ownership and audit trail stay with the market
* Execute directly under the agreed market allocation where capacity requires

**Facilitate regional standards**

* Controlled price-override standard, and a lightweight pricing-discrepancy case log with root-cause categories distinguishing data error, process error and customer-side causes (Regional Finance)
* Two-person validation standard for pricing and master data changes (Regional Finance)
* Service-contract renewal-timing standard — renewal gaps and backdating (SAPAC Service Director)
* Service-contract structure that makes preventive-maintenance parts inclusion visible in the system (SAPAC Service Director)
* Regional renewal-approval standard — documented multi-level sign-off, drawing on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with SSU leadership)
* Distributor installed-base collection standard, building on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with market leadership)
* Consistent service-hours definitions — billable / non-billable / non-productive (SAPAC Service Director)
* Structured escalation of issues outside the region's control to global process owners, with documented business impact (Global MDM / global process owners)

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated on Phase 1 results)**

* Validate the data feeding the global contract profitability reports and supplement with regional analysis, with Finance as business partner
* Like-for-like benchmarking of pricing and service KPIs across markets once definitions are standardised
* Scope further analytics with the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have**

* 4–8 years in data governance, master data management, finance operations or commercial operations, with experience facilitating standards or controls and getting them adopted across teams
* Working knowledge of SAP master data: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and installed base, service contracts
* Strong analytical skills in Excel and Power BI; comfortable profiling data, building reconciliations and presenting exceptions to senior stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority — across markets, functions and cultures, with people who do not report to you
* The ability to distinguish a data-quality symptom from the underlying process or ownership issue, and to drive prevention of recurrence rather than repeated correction
* Fluent written and spoken English; clear, concise written reporting
* Resilience and persistence — establishing a new regional capability is a marathon rather than a project

**Good to have**

* An analytics background or a clear ambition to grow into analytics — the role has a defined Phase 2 pathway into regional analytics and benchmarking
* Experience in a regulated medical-technology or life-sciences environment (ISO 13485 awareness, field safety corrective action traceability)
* Familiarity with CPQ, Salesforce or service-management systems
* Experience working with distributor channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

description:

cerebre is on a mission to build the data foundation of the physical world. We offer a live intelligence map of a facilities – built from schematics to power AI. We believe flexibility drives creativity and that our team should live and work where we can be our best selves. We’re 100% remote and offer a competitive time-off package to ensure time for rest and recharge.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Test Engineer to elevate our software quality to the next level. As a member of our technology team, you will work daily with our world-class engineers. You will think broadly to create and execute test plans that ensure our products meet the highest standards. You will apply your engineering logic and keen attention to detail to solve some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry. You will have the freedom to design and implement your testing strategies with some of the brightest minds in the space.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning and Execution: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for our software products, ensuring that they meet the highest quality standards. This includes functional, regression, and performance testing.
* P&ID Documentation Review: Work closely with P&ID technical documentation to create relevant and accurate test cases. Ensure that all aspects of the engineering design are tested and validated. Defect Identification and Management: Identify, document, and track software defects using defect management tools. Work with developers to reproduce and resolve issues, ensuring timely fixes and improvements.
* Web Application Testing: Focus on testing web applications, ensuring they function correctly across different browsers, devices, and environments. Validate that the application meets user requirements, provides a smooth user experience, and performs reliably under different conditions.
* SDLC Integration: Integrate testing processes into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), ensuring that testing is an integral part of the development and deployment process. Tool Utilization: Utilize test design tools to create efficient and effective test cases. Employ defect management tools to track and report issues, providing clear and actionable feedback to the development team.
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously seek to improve testing processes, methodologies, and tools. Stay up to date with the latest testing trends and technologies to enhance testing effectiveness and efficiency.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, to understand requirements, discuss testing strategies, and ensure alignment on quality goals.
* Technical Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of test plans, test cases, and test results. Provide clear and concise reports to the team, highlight areas of concern, and recommend improvements.
* Automation: Where applicable, identify opportunities for test automation to increase testing efficiency and coverage. Collaborate with the development team to implement automated tests as part of the CI/CD pipeline.
* Problem-Solving: Apply strong problem-solving skills to identify root causes of defects and propose solutions. Analyze test results to identify trends and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior team members and share knowledge and best practices within the team. Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
* Global Team Collaboration: Work effectively within a globally distributed remote team, communicating effectively across time zones and cultural differences. Participate in regular team meetings and contribute to the overall success of the team

**Required Skills**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Test Engineer or in a similar role
* Experience in software testing, including test design, test case creation, and defect management
* Experience testing web applications
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., TypeScript, Python, C#, or similar)
* Professional experience involving test automation
* Experience with Playwright or other test automation tools and frameworks
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving skills
* Desire to learn and continuously improve technical skills
* Ability to work effectively within a globally distributed remote team
* English proficiency at a minimum B2 level

**Preferred Skills**

* Graph Theory: Advanced knowledge of graph theory.
* TestMo: Experience using TestMo or similar test management tools.
* CAD Diagrams: Ability to read and create CAD diagrams.
* Startup Experience: Previous experience in a startup environment.
* Certification: ISTQB certification

**More About Cerebre**

We blend manufacturing process knowledge with software and big data engineering expertise to create value in physical settings

Nasdaq Technology is looking for a passionate

As a Quality Engineer Specialist, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team, ensuring the quality and reliability of critical data solutions for financial markets around the globe. **Education:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent work experience

* Infrastructure-as-Code Testing: Experience validating Terraform or CloudFormation templates
* Observability Tools: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and tracing tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, etc.)

**Risk Consulting –**
**Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) –Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**:**
We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves:
  
  

* Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
* Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
* Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
* Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence
* Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence.
* Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
* Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols.
* Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
* Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement.
* Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues.
* Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks.
* Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution.
* Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations.
* Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership.
* Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings.
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols.

**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must-have:**

* CA or Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
* 5-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
* Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
* Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
* Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
* Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
* Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation.
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‑solving skills

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
* Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
* Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
* Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
* Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Quality Auditor – Healthcare / IVF
description:
Job Title: Quality Executive

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven
**Quality Executive**
to monitor, maintain, and improve quality standards across organizational processes. The ideal candidate will have experience in quality audits, compliance monitoring, documentation, root cause analysis, and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Quality Audits & Compliance**

* Conduct internal audits, process audits, quality inspections, and compliance checks.
* Ensure adherence to Quality Management Systems (QMS), company policies, SOPs, and applicable quality standards.
* Identify process gaps, deviations, defects, and non-conformities.
* Support ISO 9001 implementation, documentation, and audit activities, where applicable.

**2. Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions**

* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone Analysis, Pareto Analysis, and PDCA.
* Develop, implement, and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Follow up on audit observations and non-conformities until closure.

**3. Documentation & Reporting**

* Develop, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, checklists, and quality records.
* Track and analyze quality KPIs, metrics, trends, and performance indicators.
* Prepare periodic quality reports, MIS reports, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Maintain accurate documentation for audits and compliance requirements.

**4. Process Improvement & Coordination**

* Identify opportunities to improve quality, operational efficiency, and organizational processes.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to resolve quality-related issues.
* Conduct awareness and training sessions on quality standards, procedures, and processes.
* Support management in implementing quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Quality Management System (QMS)
* Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC)
* Internal Auditing and Compliance
* ISO 9001 Standards
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
* 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Analysis
* SOP Preparation and Documentation
* Quality Reporting and KPI Monitoring
* Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills
* Communication and Cross-Functional Coordination

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in quality assurance, internal auditing, compliance, or process improvement.
* Strong understanding of audit procedures, quality documentation, and corrective action processes.
* Attention to detail with strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and drive process improvements.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
**QA/QC Engineer – Manufacturing**

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

💼
**Experience:**
4-10 Years

**About Manastu Space**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

🌐
**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

🔗
**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

📩
**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

To build and own the quality backbone of Manastu Space's manufacturing operations, ensuring that every propulsion component—from outsourced machined parts to in-house CNC/VMC machined assemblies—meets the highest standards of precision, safety, and traceability required for space-grade applications.

**Role Overview**

The QA/QC Engineer will be responsible for establishing and enforcing quality systems across all manufacturing activities at Manastu Space, including outsourced production and upcoming in-house machining (VMC & CNC).

This role ensures that all propulsion subsystems—including thrusters, injectors, feedlines, tanks, fixtures, and heaters—meet strict quality, safety, and traceability requirements for space applications.

**Why This Role Is Critical for Us**

Manastu Space operates at the frontier of space propulsion, where quality failures are not an option.

As we transition from outsourced manufacturing to in-house machining capabilities, this role becomes the
**quality gate between our engineering designs and flight-ready hardware**
.

The QA/QC Engineer will be the first person to own end-to-end manufacturing quality—a foundational hire who will shape our quality culture for years to come.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management System (QMS)**

* Implement and maintain the QMS for all manufacturing activities in line with AS9100D.
* Define inspection, testing, and acceptance criteria for all components and subsystems.

**2. Vendor Quality Management**

* Qualify vendors, conduct audits, and develop the Approved Vendor List (AVL).
* Define vendor quality requirements and monitor performance, including acceptance rates and rejection trends.
* Drive corrective actions for recurring vendor quality issues.

**3. Incoming, In-Process & Final Inspection**

* Establish and execute inspections at all stages: incoming materials, in-process manufacturing, and final release.
* Ensure the correct inspection tools and measurement methods are applied at each stage.

**4. Special Process Quality Control**

* Define and monitor quality for critical processes, including welding (WPS and welder qualification), precision machining, and leak-tight assemblies.
* Maintain process qualification records and ensure repeatability.

**5. Testing & Validation**

* Define and oversee testing protocols, including helium leak tests, proof/hydrostatic pressure tests, and functional checks.
* Verify that all test results meet acceptance criteria before hardware release.

**6. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions**

* Own the NCR system and lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for quality failures.
* Drive timely closure of Corrective Actions (CA) and Preventive Actions (PA), and track their effectiveness.

**7. Documentation & Traceability**

* Maintain complete, controlled documentation, including inspection reports, material certificates, and process sheets.
* Ensure full traceability for critical propulsion components, pressure parts, and welded assemblies.

**8. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Manufacturing, Design/R&D, Procurement, and Testing teams on quality matters.
* Serve as the final quality gate before hardware moves to testing or integration.

**9. In-House Manufacturing Quality Setup**

* Set up quality systems for in-house VMC and CNC operations, including First Article Inspection (FAI) and calibration management.
* Establish inspection infrastructure and measurement capability for machined components.

**10. Continuous Improvement**

* Analyse quality data and defect trends to identify systemic gaps in processes and vendor performance.
* Drive measurable improvements in quality outcomes and internal quality culture.

**11. Audit & Compliance**

* Conduct internal audits for AS9100D process and documentation compliance.
* Prepare the organisation for external audits and future quality certifications.

**12. SOP Development & Maintenance**

* Author and maintain SOPs for all manufacturing processes, inspection activities, and testing protocols, including leak tests, pressure tests, and functional checks.
* Ensure SOPs are version-controlled, reviewed periodically, and accessible to relevant team members in line with AS9100D document control requirements.

**13. Team Leadership**

* Recruit, train, and manage QA/QC inspectors and technicians as the team scales.
* Build a culture of quality ownership and accountability across manufacturing operations.

**Experience & Background**

* 4–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing quality within an aerospace, defence, or precision engineering environment.
* Demonstrated experience in:
* Machined component inspection (GD&T, CMM, gauges, and surface roughness measurement).
* Welding quality control (WPS, welder qualification, and weld inspection).
* Vendor quality management and supplier audits.
* Non-conformance management and root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone).
* Pressure system testing, including helium leak tests, hydrostatic tests, and proof pressure testing.
* Experience setting up a QMS from scratch or significantly improving existing systems is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AS9100D or equivalent aerospace quality standards (NADCAP, MIL-SPEC) is highly desirable.
* **Education:**
  B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Detail-oriented, systematic, and process-driven—someone who believes quality is built in, not inspected in.
* Strong ownership mindset, comfortable owning the quality function independently with minimal supervision.
* Effective communicator who can work constructively with vendors, manufacturing teams, and design engineers.
* Adaptable and hands-on, ready to work in a fast-paced startup environment where processes are still being established.
* Passionate about aerospace and space technology and motivated by the mission of Manastu Space.

* Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations

* Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities

* Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols.

* CA or Bachelor’s/master’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field

* Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions

title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**

We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**

Performance Engineer

Diagnose issues that an in-house performance testing team has been unable to. NA

As a Performance Engineer, a typical day involves investigating and resolving complex performance challenges that have not been addressed by the internal performance testing team. The role encompasses a broad spectrum of activities including analyzing software development processes and architecture, validating performance through rigorous testing, planning for capacity needs, managing application performance, and identifying as well as resolving issues proactively. This position requires a comprehensive approach to ensure optimal system efficiency and reliability, collaborating closely with various teams to maintain high standards of performance throughout the software lifecycle.

title: Manager, Business Process Transformation
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
The Business Process Improvement Analyst sits within the Enterprise Transformation Office. This role works under the direction of the Director of Process Transformation to engage with Service Lines or other functions across the business to diagnose root causes of pain points, understand and map current-state processes, define performance metrics and translate findings into actionable improvement recommendations including; process redesign, automation AI-enabled solutions, and draft relevant requirements.
  
  
Engagements span the full range from targeted improvements within a single business team to larger, enterprise-wide initiatives. The analyst can engage across the firm, including Tax, Assurance, Advisory and Outsourced Services Service Lines, as well as other operational teams, wherever process improvement work is needed.
  
  
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
* We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
* We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
* Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support ETO business analysts & engage as directed with business unit stakeholders to identify pain points, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities through interviews, workshops, and process observation.
* Map & analyze current-state ("as-is") processes using ETO standard notation (swim lanes, SIPOC, value stream) and validate with process owners.
* Document data flows and system touchpoints as part of process mapping, particularly where they inform automation, integration, or AI-enabled recommendations.
* Design and support the implementation of process performance metrics and KPIs (leading and lagging indicators) to baseline performance and track the impact of improvements.
* Develop future-state ("to-be") process recommendations, including process redesign, automation, and AI/technology-enabled solutions.
* Translate discovery sessions and stakeholder input into structured requirements, process documentation, and decision-ready materials for the Director and business sponsors.
* Understand what’s needed to develop credible business cases for recommended changes, including effort, cost, and expected benefits, and work to gather relevant data/information as part of the initiative documentation.
* Contribute reusable process artifacts (templates, capability maps, documentation standards) to the Process Center of Excellence to promote consistency across projects and across the firm.
* Act as a bridge between business and technology teams by clearly articulating business requirements and validating that proposed solutions address the root problem.
* Track and report on the status of improvement initiatives, flagging risks and dependencies to the Director.
* Promote a continuous improvement mindset within partner business units.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Process maps and requirements are accurate, validated by stakeholders, and reused without rework.
* KPIs/metrics are in place and actively tracked within [60–90] days of engagement start.
* Improvement recommendations are adopted by business sponsors and show measurable impact against baseline.
* Documentation meets Process COE standards and is contributed back to the shared library.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in business process analysis, operations, consulting, or transformation roles, with demonstrated ownership of process work (not just support/documentation).
* Proven ability in writing business, data, & technical requirements and the development of wireframes to clearly articulate solutions
* Proven proficiency in process mapping (current- and future-state) - able to independently run mapping sessions and produce validated, accurate artifacts with minimal oversight.
* Confident engaging business unit stakeholders directly - able to ask the right questions, surface real pain points, and read between the lines of what's said versus what's actually broken.
* Demonstrated ability to recognize and shape improvement opportunities - not just document "as-is" state, but connect root causes to practical recommendations (process, tech, automation, or AI).
* Experience defining and standing up KPIs/metrics; familiarity with Lean/Six Sigma, BPMN, or similar frameworks preferred.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable working with process and operational data to identify root causes and quantify impact.
* Ability to manage time across multiple projects and escalate when help is required.
* Working knowledge of process/workflow tools (e.g., Visio, Miro) and data/reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to automation or AI-enabled process solutions (RPA, GenAI use cases, workflow tools).
* Process improvement certification (Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP, or equivalent).
* Experience in a shared services or enterprise transformation function.

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax and business advisory firms in the U.S., with more than 5000 employees and over 450 partners across the country. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries.
  
  
We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers and investors who serve these clients. Our reach extends globally, with offices in the United Kingdom, Israel, India, the Cayman Islands, Singapore, and Ireland.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

title: Technical Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
The Technical QA Analyst ensures that all code changes and product releases are thoroughly tested and correctly implemented before deployment. The primary goal of the role is to protect product quality by identifying bugs, usability issues, and unintended side effects early, reducing incidents in live environments.
  
  
The role also plays a key part in problem definition: working closely with end users and stakeholders to understand reported issues, reproduce them accurately, and assess their scope, severity, and root conditions.
  
  
This role is expected to grow its automation capability — moving from manual and exploratory testing towards developing and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks that support faster, repeatable release validation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Test code changes, fixes, and new features prior to release, ensuring they meet functional and technical requirements.
* Validate that deployments have been implemented correctly across environments (e.g. test, staging, production).
* Identify bugs, regressions, and edge cases before and after releases.
* Document test results clearly, including steps to reproduce issues and expected vs actual behaviour.
* Support release sign-off by providing confidence-based quality assessments.
* Develop, maintain and execute automated test scripts and test plans to validate software functionality and regression coverage.
* Contribute to the build-out of automated testing frameworks, working towards integration within the CI/CD pipeline over time.

**Issue Reproduction & Analysis**

* Work with end users, product teams, and support teams to understand reported issues.
* Recreate problems in test environments to determine:

+ How widespread the issue is
+ Under what conditions it occurs
+ Whether it is intermittent or consistent
+ What makes the issue better or worse

* Distinguish between user error, configuration issues, data-related problems, and genuine defects.
* Provide structured findings to developers to support fast and accurate fixes.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with software engineers, product managers, and IT colleagues throughout the development and release lifecycle.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical users by translating user experience into clear technical detail.
* Provide feedback to improve testing processes, release checklists, and documentation.

**Process Improvement**

* Help improve test coverage and testing approaches over time (with a growing emphasis on automation, alongside manual and exploratory testing where appropriate).
* Contribute to quality standards for releases and change management.
* Identify recurring problem patterns and suggest preventative improvements.

**Essential**
**Skills & Experience**

* Experience working in a technical or IT environment (QA, testing, support, engineering, or similar).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to methodically reproduce and isolate technical issues.
* Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to testing.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining issues and impact.
* Comfortable working with developers and technical systems.
* Foundational understanding of, or demonstrable interest in, test automation — including scripting, automation frameworks or tools (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing.

**Desirable**

* Experience testing software applications, platforms, or internal systems.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and release processes.
* Familiarity with bug tracking or ticketing tools.
* Basic understanding of code, APIs, databases, or system configuration — including the ability to write or interpret basic test scripts.
* Experience with regression testing, UAT, or exploratory testing.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools or CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious and investigative mindset.
* Patient and persistent when tracking down complex or intermittent issues.
* Comfortable asking questions and challenging assumptions.
* User-focused: concerned with how real people experience the product.
* Calm and structured, particularly during incidents or release windows.
* Eager to grow technical skills, particularly in test automation and quality engineering.

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**

* Fewer bugs and incidents reaching live environments.
* Faster resolution of reported issues due to clear reproduction and diagnosis.
* Increased confidence in releases from both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Improved understanding of product behaviour and risk areas over time.
* Growing test automation coverage, reducing reliance on manual regression testing over time.

**Why join YouGov?**
Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.
  
  
Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.
  
  
**Life at YouGov**
We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

title: Food Technologist
description:
Hiring: Food Technologist – In-House Manufacturing, Quality & Food Safety

**Location:**
Andheri East, Mumbai (Manufacturing Facility)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Department:**
Manufacturing / Operations

**Reports To:**
Founders / Head of Operations

Role Purpose

The Food Technologist will be the technical owner of in-house food manufacturing, responsible for ensuring all products are safe, compliant, consistent, shelf-stable, and scalable.

This role has end-to-end responsibility from raw material intake to finished goods dispatch, with authority over production processes, quality control, food safety systems, and factory discipline.

This is a hands-on factory-floor role, not a desk-based QA position.

Scope of Authority

The Food Technologist is authorized to:

* Stop production in case of quality or food safety risk
* Approve or reject raw materials, in-process batches, and finished goods
* Define and enforce SOPs, GMP, and HACCP requirements
* Set and modify production process parameters
* Lead corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

Key Responsibilities1. In-House Production Management

* Own daily production operations across all SKUs
* Define and control batch sizes and process parameters
* Monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity)
* Ensure production targets, yields, and timelines are met
* Troubleshoot issues related to texture, binding, moisture, breakage, and packaging
* Minimise downtime, rework, and wastage

2. Product Development & Scale-Up

* Translate R&D formulations into production-ready recipes
* Conduct pilot trials and commercial validation batches
* Optimise formulations for:
* Shelf life
* Process stability
* Ingredient functionality
* Cost efficiency
* Support new product launches from trial to full-scale production

3. Quality Control & Quality Assurance

* Design and implement factory-wide QC systems
* Define quality specifications and acceptance criteria
* Oversee:
* Incoming raw material checks
* In-process quality controls
* Finished goods inspections
* Review and approve batch manufacturing records
* Manage non-conformances, deviations, and CAPAs

4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Compliance

* Implement and maintain GMP and HACCP systems
* Ensure compliance with FSSAI regulations
* Maintain food safety documentation and records
* Lead internal and external audits
* Act as the primary food safety contact for regulatory authorities

5. Shelf Life, Stability & Packaging Control

* Design and execute shelf-life and stability studies
* Monitor oxidation, moisture migration, texture changes, and sensory drift
* Validate packaging materials and sealing integrity
* Define storage and distribution conditions
* Implement natural shelf-life enhancement strategies

6. Raw Material & Supplier Quality

* Approve raw material specifications and suppliers
* Monitor ingredient variability and seasonal changes
* Handle supplier quality issues and corrective actions
* Maintain COAs and full traceability

7. Documentation & Traceability

* Create and maintain:
* SOPs
* Work instructions
* Batch records
* Cleaning and sanitation logs
* Ensure full lot traceability and recall readiness
* Conduct mock recall drills when required

8. Team Training & Factory Discipline

* Train production staff on SOPs, hygiene, and quality checkpoints
* Enforce hygiene and food safety behaviour
* Build a quality-first culture on the factory floor
* Support hiring and evaluation of production staff

9. Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimisation

* Lead initiatives for yield improvement and waste reduction
* Optimise ingredient usage without compromising quality
* Improve line efficiency and process robustness
* Track and report production and quality KPIs

Qualifications & ExperienceEducation

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Nutrition, or related fields

Experience

* 5–10 years of hands-on experience in in-house food manufacturing
* Strong factory-floor exposure
* Experience with shelf-stable products preferred
* Audit and inspection handling experience required

Skills & Competencies

* Food chemistry and ingredient functionality
* Shelf-life science and packaging interactions
* HACCP and GMP implementation
* Root-cause analysis and problem-solving
* Strong documentation and execution discipline
* Leadership and decision-making under pressure

Career Growth Path

Food Technologist → Production & Quality Head → Plant Head / Operations Head

title: IBM BPM Devloper
description:
**Role: IBM BPM Developer/BAW Developer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai (local candidates only)**

**Job Type: Fulltime**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Budget: Upto 9 LPA**

**Immediate to 30 Days notice only**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled IBM BPM / BAW Developer with a strong background in Java/JEE enterprise application development and relational databases. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end process automation workflows.

A critical component of this role involves utilizing IBM Integration Designer (IID) to build Advanced Integration Services (AIS), BPEL processes, and mediation flows that bridge our workflow engine with complex enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between process modelling (Process Designer) and complex backend enterprise integration (IID/Java/SQL).

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Process Automation & Workflow Development**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end process models using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / IBM BPM (Process Designer).
* Create and maintain standard/advanced client-side human services, coach views, and custom UI components using JavaScript/CSS.
* Implement complex process logic, tracking groups, timers, gateways, and UCA (Undercover Agents) event handling.

2.
**Advanced Integration & Middleware (IID)**

* Utilize IBM Integration Designer (IID) to develop robust Advanced Integration Services (AIS), Service Component Architecture (SCA) modules, and BPEL (Business Process Execution Language) processes.
* Design and configure custom Mediation Flows, data transformations (XSLT/BO Maps), and adapters (JDBC, Flat File, Web Services) within IID.
* Build, expose, and consume secure corporate enterprise web services (REST APIs and SOAP/WSDL protocols) using XML and JSON data mapping.

3.
**Java Stack & Core Backend Customization**

* Develop custom server-side plugins, integration components, and utility classes using Core Java / JEE to handle complex business logic outside standard out-of-the-box BPM capabilities.
* Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java code, managing object mappings, dependency injection, and advanced multithreaded processing configurations.

4.
**Database & Performance Optimization**

* Write complex, high-performance SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to interact with enterprise relational databases (e.g., Oracle, IBM DB2, or MS SQL Server).
* Design data schemas and optimize database interactions within BPM integration services to minimize latency and avoid process blocking.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve performance bottlenecks across the BPM runtime, IID SCA modules, and backend database layers.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* BPM Platform: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience explicitly working with IBM BAW (25.x) ecosystems.
* Integration Tooling: Proven expertise with IBM Integration Designer (IID) building advanced SOA-based integration layers and long-running BPEL flows.
* Java Stack: Strong programming proficiency in Core Java, JEE, Hibernate/JPA, and web services infrastructure.
* Database Stack: Solid working knowledge of relational database management systems (RDBMS) with excellent SQL query optimization and stored procedure debugging skills.
* Web Technologies: Comprehensive understanding of Web Services (RESTful APIs, SOAP, WSDL), data exchange formats (XML, XSD, JSON), and frontend languages (JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3).
* Methodology: Strong experience working within an Agile/Scrum development model.

**Soft Skills & Educational Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills to trace data across decoupled components (Process Center \rightarrow Advanced Integration Layer / rightarrow DB Engine).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with business analysts, system architects, and project stakeholders.

**Preferred Certifications (Good to Have)**

* IBM Certified Application Developer - Business Automation Workflow / BPM
* Oracle Certified Associate/Professional Java Programmer (OCAJP / OCPJP)

title: API Support Engineer
description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.
